Who can see it
Only you, on your own phone, and WASAC staff. Staff see your photo only when they check a reading.
How long photos are kept
Meter photos are deleted after 90 days. A photo you never sent is deleted after one day.

Only to see whether the photo was taken at your meter. If not, an officer looks at the reading. Your reading is never refused because of this alone.
